delivery_evidence: Teacher PD = five full-day in-person workshops offered during summer and across the school year, facilitated by district coordinators (face-to-face, with collaborative planning time); no online delivery of the workshops described (Method 'Teacher workshops', p.~10-11 / pp.403-405).
test_alignment_evidence: The two full-sample included outcomes are a researcher-developed science assessment (NAEP/TIMSS/state-release items; proximal/aligned) AND the high-stakes state science assessment (broad independent/distal); test_type mixes researcher_made and standardized_independent (Tables 4-5, p.19-20).
curriculum_evidence: P-SELL is a standalone year-long fifth-grade science curriculum (with teacher's guide / educative curriculum materials) that teachers adopt and implement; the workshops focus on implementing that curriculum vs business-as-usual district-adopted textbooks (Method 'The P-SELL intervention', pp.401-405).
outcome_timing_evidence: Outcomes measured at end of Year 1 (researcher-developed posttest spring 2013; state test April 2013), same school year as the treatment year; no post-treatment follow-up wave for the extracted effects (Table 4, p.19; extraction timepoint 'post (end of Year 1)').
